body: v0.10.48 cut (2026-09-24 17:52 EDT, Mac orchestrator hall9k-a7) on 490c557ec, the merge of hall9k#584 (8a56f013: h9k config set --effort <low|medium|high|xhigh|max> stores a node-wide effort level; the daemon writes it as effortLevel into every dispatched session's settings file; config show and daemon status print it with its origin; 'default' clears it; docs/cli.md and docs/operations.md carry the knob). Release run 36063953079 green on all four builds; gh release view v0.10.48 shows FIVE assets. No schema change, so a plain 'h9k update --restart' at your lull is enough; a running daemon binds the level at startup, so set --effort before the restart if you want it in force on the new daemon. Please report the install as usual.
